test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Final goods are divided into:
solution:
The correct answer is __**consumption goods and capital goods.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Final goods:-**

 
 
• These are those goods that are ready for consumption or use by the end consumer.
 
 
 
• **Consumption goods:-**
 
 
• These are those goods that are used for immediate satisfaction of human needs and wants, such as food, clothing, and electronics.
 
 
 
• **Capital goods:-**
 
 
• These are those goods that are used to produce other goods and services, such as machinery and equipment. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raw materials:-**

 
 
• These are those materials that are used to produce goods, while semi-finished goods are those goods that are partially completed but still require further processing to become final goods.
 
 
 
• **Single goods:-**
 
 
• These are those goods that are not composed of multiple parts or components, while composite goods are those goods that are composed of multiple parts or components.
